entries.title: Acts 11:1
segments: Now the apostles and the brothers that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God;

entries.title: Acts 11:2
segments: so, when Peter came up to Jerusalem, the circumcision party disputed with him,

entries.title: Acts 11:3
segments: saying, "You went into the houses of the uncircumcised and ate with them!"

entries.title: Acts 11:4
segments: Then Peter began and explained the whole matter to them in order, saying:

entries.title: Acts 11:5
segments: "I was in the city of Joppa, praying, and while in a trance I saw a vision; a certain vessel descending, what seemed to be an enormous sail let down to me,

entries.title: Acts 11:6
segments: and while I gazed at it, I examined it carefully, and saw the quadrupeds of the earth and the wild beasts and creeping things and the wild birds.

entries.title: Acts 11:7
segments: I also heard a voice saying to me, `Rise, Peter, kill and eat.'

entries.title: Acts 11:8
segments: "`Not so, my Lord' said I, `for nothing common or unclean has ever gone into my mouth.'

entries.title: Acts 11:9
segments: "But for the second time a voice spoke from the sky, `What God has cleansed, you must not call common.'

entries.title: Acts 11:10
segments: "This was said three times, and then everything was drawn up again into the sky.

entries.title: Acts 11:11
segments: "And lo! at that very moment, three men who had been sent for me from Caesarea stood before the house in which I was.

entries.title: Acts 11:12
segments: "And the Spirit bade me accompany them without misgiving. There also accompanied me these six brothers, and we went into the man's house.

entries.title: Acts 11:13
segments: "Then he told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying: "`Send to Joppa and fetch Simon who is also called Peter.

entries.title: Acts 11:14
segments: "`He will speak words to you by which you and all your family will be saved.'

entries.title: Acts 11:15
segments: "And," said Peter, "as soon as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as he fell upon us at the beginning.

entries.title: Acts 11:16
segments: "Then I remembered the words of the Lord, how he used to say, "`John indeed baptized in water, but you shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit.'

entries.title: Acts 11:17
segments: "So if God gave them the same gift as he gave to us, when we first believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could withstand God?"

entries.title: Acts 11:18
segments: On hearing this they held their peace and glorified God, saying, "Forsooth then, to the Gentiles also God has granted repentance unto life."

entries.title: Acts 11:19
segments: Then those who had been scattered by the trouble that arose over Stephen, traveled as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch; but they preached the word to none except Jews.

entries.title: Acts 11:20
segments: Some of them, however, were Cyprians and Cyrenaeans, who, on reaching Antioch, began to tell the Greeks also the Good News concerning the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Acts 11:21
segments: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number who believed turned to the Lord.

entries.title: Acts 11:22
segments: When news of this reached the ears of the church at Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch.

entries.title: Acts 11:23
segments: When he arrived, and saw the grace of God, he was glad, and he encouraged them all to remain faithful to the Lord, with full purpose of heart;

entries.title: Acts 11:24
segments: for he was a good man, and full of faith and the Holy Spirit. And a great multitude was added to the Lord.

entries.title: Acts 11:25
segments: Then Barnabas visited Tarsus, to try to find Saul,

entries.title: Acts 11:26
segments: and when he had found him he brought him to Antioch, where for a whole year they were guests of the church, and taught many people. And it was in Antioch that the disciples first received the name of "Christians."

entries.title: Acts 11:27
segments: At that time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

entries.title: Acts 11:28
segments: One of them, who was Agabus, rose up, and being instructed by the Spirit, predicted that a great famine was about to come upon the whole inhabited earth. (It came in the reign of Claudius.)

entries.title: Acts 11:29
segments: So the disciples decided to send relief, every man according to his means, to the brothers in Judea.

entries.title: Acts 11:30
segments: This they did, forwarding their contributions to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
